purpose: This table provides one row per physical runway, cleaned of Airbyte capture metadata, feeding downstream airport-infrastructure analytics that join to an airports dimension via airport_ref/airport_ident.
usage: Join on airport_ref or airport_ident to enrich with airport details, and treat le_/he_ (low-end/high-end) latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns as independently nullable since each end of a runway is profiled separately; consumers must handle nulls in displaced-threshold and geo columns rather than assume a value.
limitations: le_displaced_threshold_ft (88.4% null) and he_displaced_threshold_ft (90.0% null) are very sparse and were not imputed; le_/he_ latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns each carry roughly 22-28% nulls reflecting incomplete source surveys, and surface remains free text with 239 distinct unnormalized codes rather than a controlled vocabulary.
